answer: Audits are published in ripple, queued in echo, and mesa publishes the wait time. A farm of 285 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 70 identities per epoch. A farm of 2687 identities would post 2034 proofs and burn roughly 64 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
